title: 765. Largest Plus Sign

examples.explanation: One mine still leaves a center with one-step arms.
The middle of a full grid reaches one cell each way.

hints: Build a banned set from mines, then precompute consecutive-one runs left, right, up, and down for every cell.
Each direction can be filled in one linear sweep; the plus at (r,c) is the minimum of the four runs.
Track the maximum of those minima over all cells.
